M1.reason: Matches the brief's words: a chunky box body (about 7.4 by 10.4 by 18) on a hazard-striped plinth, with a small block on top. In the front, left, back and right views the body is a single straight-sided box with no part sticking out or missing. The front-left and back-left oblique views keep the same outline.

M2.reason: Measured 7.4 x 10.4 x 18 against the brief's 18 tall and 10 across. Height is exact, width is 4% over, and sizeOff is 0.04, well within 15%.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, checked down to the small ones: body, stubby handle on top (front view at about x 152-232, y 48-112, centred in the left and right views), two green glowing panels on the front (one thin strip above one larger panel, front view at about y 127-230), and a hazard-stripe band around the base (front view at about y 288-335, carried round the back and sides). No claws, teeth, rivets or tabs are asked for. Nothing is missing or doubled. The handle reads as a block more than a grip, which the brief's 'stubby' allows.

M4.reason: Grey metal body in dark charcoal-grey, bright green glow on the panels, black and yellow hazard stripes on the plinth, all as the brief names them. The body is darker than a light grey, but it is still a grey metal. The rust-brown patches on the handle are paint, not a colour the brief rules out.

M5.reason: Green panels, hazard stripes and the plinth's edge highlights are present in their places and reasonably sharp in the front and front-left views. The rust speckle on the handle and the speckled underside are extra wear the brief does not ask for, and they add nothing wrong.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test. Across four readings with the asset in a different slot each time, the judges never picked it as the one not made by Valve (they picked B, C, A, D). The test passed.

M7.reason: Upright, and it stands on its plinth at the origin, as a battery on the floor should. The front is the face with the two green panels, and it is square to the views. The brief says 'lying on the floor', which reads as resting on the floor, not as lying on its side, so standing upright is consistent with the brief.

M8.reason: checkErrors is empty. 36 triangles against a Half-Life median of 56 for its kind, so well under twice the median. The outline reads as closed in every side view and the top. The underside is dark and speckled but is not visible to the player.
